explanation: A heavy fast body (M=20, v=55) strikes a light body (m=0.2) resting just left of a thin wall (x=12,w=0.1). The collision resolves non-physically (heavy rebounds to vx~-22.5, light ejects at vx~501.6, violating 1D elastic momentum), and the light body is displaced across the wall in a single step (x 11.44 -> 19.31), so its centre crosses through the wall box: no_tunneling violation caused by impulse/positional handling of near-simultaneous body-body and body-wall contacts combined with insufficient substep CCD for the ejected fragment.
